source_records.context: - [GCR-PPO](https://github.com/humphreymunn/GCR-PPO) — GCR-PPO is a modified Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) algorithm designed for multi-objective robot reinforcement learning. It features a multi-head critic for per-reward advantage estimation and uses priority-aware gradient surgery (inspired by PCGrad) to preserve task objectives during regularization. The implementation is optimized for massively parallel GPU execution within Isaac Lab using the RSL-RL framework, making it suitable for researchers and developers working on complex robotic control tasks in NVIDIA's Isaac Sim ecosystem. ![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/humphreymunn/GCR-PPO?style=social)
